personality_one_liner: A nocturnal lunar-lit command surface for on-demand vehicle care, blending deep slate blacks with electric moonlit cyan accents and frosted glass depth.

spacing.rule: Generous touch spacing with compact metric density for operational speed

do's: Use frosted glass headers over scrolling content
Apply translucent cards with subtle light borders over dark backgrounds
Ensure ≥75% surface tint opacity under blur for absolute readability
dont's: Avoid pure black screens; use obsidian/slate gradients
Do not blur form inputs or body text
Never use unreadable text on bright neon highlights

screens.name: Auth
screens.purpose: Email/password authentication with bilingual EN/ID toggle and lunar branding backdrop.

states.empty: Clean input form ready for entry
states.error: Inline toast alert for invalid login with retry button

screens.layout: Vertical stack with top-right language toggle, hero moonlit branding header, form inputs, and secure sign-in CTA.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Command center for service browsing, active vehicle status, and quick booking triggers.

states.loading: Skeleton placeholders for services and vehicle cards
states.empty: Prompt to add first vehicle and select service package
states.error: Connection error banner with retry action

screens.layout: Scrollable feed with sticky glass header, hero moonlit car banner, quick service category pills, and featured detailing tiers.

screens.name: ServiceSelection
screens.purpose: Detailed browsing and customization of 4-wheeled vehicle detailing and maintenance packages.

states.empty: No services available in region message
states.error: Failed to fetch service catalog with retry button

screens.layout: Categorized tabbed list with expandable service cards, inclusions checklist, and sticky bottom price summary with Book CTA.

screens.name: VehicleManagement
screens.purpose: Select or add 4-wheeled vehicles (Sedan, SUV, Luxury, Van) with license plate and make/model details.

states.empty: Empty garage illustration with 'Add Vehicle' CTA
states.error: Failed to sync garage data with retry button

screens.layout: Grid/List of garage vehicles with quick select radio, plus floating button to add new vehicle modal with manual form.

screens.name: AddressSchedule
screens.purpose: Home service location selection via map/manual form and date/time time slot scheduling.

states.loading: Fetching GPS location and available slots
states.empty: Prompt to set pin or enter address manually
states.error: Location services disabled warning with manual entry fallback

screens.layout: Split map header preview with manual address inputs below, followed by horizontal date selector and time slot grid.

screens.name: OrderConfirmation
screens.purpose: Comprehensive order review without payment (service summary, vehicle, home address, schedule) prior to dispatch.

states.error: Failed to generate confirmation token with retry

screens.layout: Receipt-style card stack with itemized breakdown, location map snapshot, and sticky 'Confirm Dispatch' button.

screens.name: OrderTracking
screens.purpose: Real-time service status tracking from dispatch to arrival, execution, and completion.

states.empty: No active service orders in progress
states.error: Connection lost; reconnecting to live status...

screens.layout: Interactive map tracker header with vertical progress timeline (Dispatched -> Arrived -> Detailing -> Completed) and specialist contact card.

screens.name: OrderHistory
screens.purpose: Log of past and cancelled vehicle maintenance orders with quick re-order and invoice access.

states.empty: No past maintenance history illustration with service CTA
states.error: Failed to retrieve order logs with retry

screens.layout: Chronological list of service history cards with status badges (Completed, Cancelled), total cost, and invoice action.

screens.name: InvoiceDetail
screens.purpose: Detailed itemized invoice view for completed services with bilingual export support.

states.error: Failed to load invoice file with retry

screens.layout: Document card with company letterhead, itemized service breakdown, vehicle specs, and sticky 'Download PDF / Print' action.

hero_banner.alt: Moonlit luxury vehicle detailing garage environment

empty_state.alt: Dark modern parking garage empty state visual

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the application 'Moontir' as an on-demand 4-wheeled vehicle service and detailing app with a moon-themed modern UI/UX.
Adhere strictly to Personality 7 (Dark-First Utility DARK) combined with glassmorphism over deep obsidian/slate backgrounds (#0C0E14) and moonlit cyan accents (#3B82F6, #93C5FD).
Implement bilingual support (Indonesian / English) with an instant header toggle across all core screens.
Ensure zero payment flow as per user choice; order confirmation creates dispatch orders directly.
Include full support for manual address forms plus device location/map integration.
Incorporate sticky bottom action CTAs on all booking and checkout screens with proper safe-area bottom padding.
Ensure all interactive elements have touch targets >= 44x44pt and use Phosphor icons consistently.
